headline: Centre Approves BharatNet Subsidy in Tamil Nadu
summary: The Centre approved a BharatNet subsidy to cover over five lakh rural fibre connections in Tamil Nadu.

headline: Tamil Nadu Raises Health Insurance Income Limit
summary: Tamil Nadu has increased the annual income eligibility limit for health insurance to 2.5 lakh rupees.

headline: Age Relaxation Announced for TNPSC Group Exams
summary: Tamil Nadu has granted a five-year age relaxation for applicants appearing for TNPSC Group examinations.

headline: Tamil Nadu Projects 6,162 MW Power Deficit
summary: Tamil Nadu revised its peak evening power demand forecast to cross 24,000 MW, with a projected deficit of 6,162 MW.

headline: Police Recapture 17 Escaped Remand Prisoners
summary: All 17 remand prisoners who escaped from Theni district jail under cover of darkness were apprehended within 42 hours.

headline: ISRO Launches Next-Generation NVS-03 Navigation Satellite
summary: The NVS-03 satellite, carrying atomic clocks, was placed into orbit to help restore the functioning of India's NavIC navigation system.

headline: India Criticizes Global Energy Market Distortions
summary: A Union minister highlighted that sanctions, obstacles, and chokepoints are increasingly distorting global energy markets with wider complex impacts.

headline: Supreme Court Rules On Consensual Sex Cases
summary: The Supreme Court stated that failed relationships cannot turn consensual sex into rape, distinguishing consent from post-relationship regret.

headline: Supreme Court Addresses Online Court Feed Misuse
summary: The Supreme Court asked the Centre to take action against the online misuse of official courtroom video feeds.

headline: Jaishankar Meets Canadian Counterpart At G20 Event
summary: External Affairs Minister Jaishankar held bilateral talks with Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand on the sidelines of the G20 meeting.
